title: Dispatch through a shared interface
description: Polymorphism lets you call a shared interface on different concrete classes. The page describes a vtable as the function-pointer table used for virtual calls.

steps.description: Shape declares a virtual destructor and two pure virtual operations, which derived classes must implement. Its default describe calls those operations.
Circle implements area and perimeter using its radius. It inherits Shape's describe implementation.
Rectangle implements area and perimeter using width and height. It also replaces describe with its own implementation.
The vector owns different shapes through unique_ptr<Shape>. Each describe call selects the implementation for that object's class.
dynamic_cast checks a derived type at runtime. typeid requests the object's runtime type information.
